subject: Private Control Plane — SAML assertion-only mode + SCIM delta sync troubleshooting
messages:
From: Acme Corp SRE <acme-sre@acme.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private CP initial cutover - SAML assertion mode + SCIM gap

Hi Hannah —

We kicked off the smoke tests this morning after importing the SAML metadata you provided. Two issues popped up that look related to assertion-only mode + SCIM delta sync: 

1) SAML assertions that include the operator_role claim are accepted by the control plane, but the mapped operator accounts are not visible in the UI until a full SCIM resync. Delta events (PATCH) from our IdP are arriving (we can see them in our logs) but Redwood's SCIM endpoint is returning 202 with empty updates.

2) When we trigger a forced SCIM resync the operator accounts appear but their RBAC bindings are missing; the role mapping CSV we provided should map assertion value `acme:operator` -> `priv_operator`, but the bindings are being created as `viewer` instead.

Attached: scim-delta-sample.log (delta events we sent), acme-saml-metadata.xml, privcp-role-mappings-v1.csv

Can the Redwood team advise: is there an expected race between assertion-only auth and SCIM provisioning? We want to avoid doing a full resync during cutover. Also happy to hop on a quick debug call — afternoon PT today or Monday.

Thanks,
Sam Rao
SRE, Acme Corp

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Acme Corp SRE <acme-sre@acme.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private CP initial cutover - SAML assertion mode + SCIM gap

Sam —

Thanks for the clear repro artifacts, and for attaching the logs. Quick summary from our side after an initial look: 

- SCIM delta handling: our control plane will accept PATCH deltas but only applies deltas to local operator resources if the provisioning engine has already materialized the external identity mapping. In assertion-only flows, it's possible the auth assertion is evaluated before the SCIM PATCH is applied, which leads to a short window where the operator exists for auth-time checks but not in the persistent provisioned store used by the UI.

- Role mapping fallback: if the provisioning job receives a SCIM PATCH without an explicit role attribute (or if the role CSV mapping lookup fails due to whitespace/charset differences), we fall back to a default role (viewer) to avoid granting excessive privileges.

Action items I propose: 
1) Dev to validate delta consumption pipeline and add a strict race-tolerant path so assertion-time identity can reference the incoming delta if materialization is pending (temporary in-memory apply). (assigned: dev_patel)
2) Ops to validate CSV parsing and trim/normalize incoming attributes; add unit check that maps acme:operator -> priv_operator. (assigned: karthik_iyer)
3) Customer recommendation: for cutover window, trigger a targeted on-demand SCIM PATCH for operator accounts (idempotent) immediately after test assertion to avoid full resync. We'll supply a small script you can run.

Can we schedule a 30-minute debug session today at 3:30pm PT? If that doesn't work, Monday 10:00am PT works for our team.

-Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Principal PM, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Acme Corp SRE <acme-sre@acme.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 13:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private CP initial cutover - SAML assertion mode + SCIM gap

Hi all —

I dug into the scim-delta-sample.log you sent. Two concrete bugs I can reproduce locally: 

A) Our PATCH handler ignores `operations[value]` when the incoming JSON uses a `schemas` array ordering that differs from the generator (Okta sends a different ordering for some events). I've pushed a fix to the staging branch that normalizes schema keys before applying the patch.

B) The role-mapping lookup was doing a straight string equality; Acme's CSV (thanks) contains `acme:operator` for one line (Windows CR). I'm adding a normalization pass to trim CR/LF and to lower-case keys for mapping.

I'll cut a hotfix branch and roll it to our private staging control plane tonight. If you can re-run the delta events after I push, that will confirm both fixes.

Attachment: link to staging deploy logs (internal) — I've pasted an excerpt below for quick reference.

Excerpts:
- PATCH processed id=evt-20270409-81, normalized schemas, applied 1 delta to operator/id=acme-sam
- role mapping matched `acme:operator` -> `priv_operator` (applied)

I'll coordinate with Ben on an automated small-script you can run during cutover to POST idempotent PATCHes.

-Dev
Senior Software Engineer, Runtime

From: Acme Corp SRE <acme-sre@acme.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private CP initial cutover - SAML assertion mode + SCIM gap

Thanks Dev — that lines up with what we saw. We re-ran the delta series after 09:15 PT and confirmed that the operator records were created and the RBAC bindings are now `priv_operator`. No UI lag after the targeted PATCH. 

One follow-on: during our tests we noticed token lifetimes for SAML assertions cached in the control plane (KV cache) are 10m by default; that means an operator who authenticates before the SCIM PATCH might be able to make calls for up to 10m using attributes that will be retroactively changed by provisioning. Can Redwood reduce the assertion TTL to 30s during the cutover window, or provide a way to invalidate assertion cache for specific identities?

Also attaching the updated scim log for your records.

—Sam

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Acme Corp SRE <acme-sre@acme.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private CP initial cutover - SAML assertion mode + SCIM gap

Sam / team —

Great to hear the targeted PATCH cleared the gap. Quick notes & next steps we agreed on during the debug call: 

- Short-term (this week):
  * We will expose an `invalidate_assertion_cache` API endpoint on the private control plane for customer operator IDs (non-privileged call that requires a signed request from the customer admin). Ben will own the implementation and provide the client script. (owner: ben_carter)
  * We will add a cutover profile toggle that temporarily reduces assertion TTL to 30s for the cutover window. This will be gated behind a config flag in the private control plane config. (owner: dev_patel)

- Medium-term (Q2):
  * Make delta application more race-tolerant by allowing in-memory pre-materialization for assertion-evaluated identities for a short window (30s), then persist. This reduces need for forced PATCHes. (owner: dev_patel / karthik_iyer)
  * Improve role mapping diagnostics: when a fallback occurs, emit an actionable audit event with the original external attribute + matched fallback.

- Docs & cutover runbook: Laura will update the Private deployment cutover runbook with the targeted-PATCH script, the cache-invalidation flow, and recommended validation steps (owner: laura_bennett).

I'll circulate the client script and the temporary config flag details once Ben and Dev have the artifacts. Thanks for the rapid collaboration — let us know if you want Redwood to run the targeted PATCH from our side during cutover (we can, but we prefer customer-triggered for auditability).

Best,
Hannah

[Attachments included: acme-saml-metadata.xml, scim-delta-sample.log, privcp-role-mappings-v1.csv]
